raw_text:
PLAN "Couch to 5K with Strength, Intervals, Tempo & Parkrun - Asthma Safe (Faster Finish) + Race Prep"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Run 5K continuously, increase race pace, and build full-body strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk/Jog + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 6x1..1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Walk/Jog + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 8x1..1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x7..7 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Easy Continuous":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x10..10 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 48m "Walk/Jog + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 6x1..2 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x35..35 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Walk/Jog + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 5x2..2 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Tempo Intro":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x5..5 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 3x3..3 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Walk/Jog + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 4x3..3 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x40..40 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Continuous Jog + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x15..15 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x60..60 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Interval Progression + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 5x2..2 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          jogging 3x4..4 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Long Intervals + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 3x6..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Steady Longer":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x20..20 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Endurance Build + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x22..22 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m

  PHASE "Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Steady Run + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x25..25 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "VO2 Intervals + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 6x2..2 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          jogging 4x1..1 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Tempo Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x20..20 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 2x5..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Continuous Increase + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x30..30 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Tempo Intervals + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 5x4..4 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          jogging 6x1..1 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x4..4 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Long Run":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x32..32 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Steady Run + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x34..34 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Interval Peak + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 4x7..7 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          jogging 6x1..1 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Tempo Run + Endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x25..25 rpe 8 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x10..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m

  PHASE "Polish" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Manageable Long Run + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x38..38 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Sharp Intervals + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 8x1..1 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          jogging 5x2..2 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x5..5 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Long Run":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x40..40 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Saturday training 90m "Parkrun Test (5K)":
        warmup:
          walking 15m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x30..30 rpe 8 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x5..5 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 15m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Sustained Run + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x42..42 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Taper Intervals + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 6x2..2 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          jogging 4x1..1 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Tempo Maintenance":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x15..15 rpe 7 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 2x5..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Easy Run + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x25..25 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Short Intervals + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 8x1..1 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          jogging 6x2..2 rpe 9 rest 75 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Race Pace Intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 8x2..2 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Easy Maintenance + Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x28..28 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Race Pace Tune + Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 6x3..3 rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          jogging 4x1..1 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
          walking 1x6..6 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Restorative Run":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x20..20 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

  PHASE "Race Prep" (1 week):
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Easy Run + Light Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x12..12 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x30..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Pre-Race Prep + Tune":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 4x2..2 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking 1x4..4 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          push_up 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Pre-Race Activation":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 4x1..1 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          jogging 2x2..2 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Saturday training 90m "Race Day - Parkrun Simulation":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          jogging 1x30..30 rpe 8 rest 0 seconds
          jogging 1x5..5 rpe 9 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 20m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Recovery Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x15..15 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
